1️⃣ What is AI vs ML vs DL?

Artificial Intelligence (AI)
Broad field of making machines simulate human intelligence.

Machine Learning (ML)
Subset of AI where systems learn patterns from data instead of being explicitly programmed.

Deep Learning (DL)
Subset of ML using neural networks with many layers.

2️⃣ Types of Machine Learning
🔹 Supervised Learning
Data is labeled.
Tasks:
Regression → Predict continuous value (e.g., house price)
Classification → Predict category (e.g., spam/not spam)
Algorithms:
Linear Regression
Logistic Regression
KNN
SVM
Decision Trees
Random Forest
Neural Networks
🔹 Unsupervised Learning
No labels.
Tasks:
Clustering → K-Means, DBSCAN
Dimensionality Reduction → PCA, t-SNE
Association Rules → Apriori
🔹 Reinforcement Learning
Agent interacts with environment.
Learns via rewards and penalties.
Key terms:
Agent
Environment
Reward
Policy
Q-learning
3️⃣ ML Workflow
Data Collection
Data Cleaning
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
Feature Engineering
Train/Test Split
Model Training
Model Evaluation
Hyperparameter Tuning
Deployment
4️⃣ Important Concepts
📌 Overfitting vs Underfitting
Overfitting: Model memorizes training data.
Underfitting: Model too simple.
Solution:
Cross-validation
Regularization
More data
Dropout (DL)
📌 Bias-Variance Tradeoff
High Bias → Underfitting
High Variance → Overfitting
Goal: Balance both
📌 Evaluation Metrics
Regression
MAE
MSE
RMSE
R²
Classification
Accuracy
Precision
Recall
F1 Score
ROC-AUC
